name: Madang
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage's start point for the coast and the region page's headline city; harbour, swimming spots and walkable town.
objection: Small town with little to see beyond the harbour; may be better as a destination than a spot.

name: Madang Central Market
reason: Rules 1,2,4: Wikivoyage Do/Buy lists a daily market (every day except Sunday), a permanent venue.
objection: Mostly fruit and vegetables, few souvenirs, and it is shut Sundays.

name: Coastwatchers Lighthouse
reason: Rules 1-3: working lighthouse and memorial on Madang harbour named by Wikivoyage and a city guide ('synonymous with Madang'), a second-tier landmark icon.
objection: Could be read as a minor memorial and a short stop; interior probably closed.

name: Madang Museum
reason: Rule 1 only via Wikipedia citing Lonely Planet; small ethnographic museum open to visitors but I could not open a counted page.
objection: For: real museum with collections, guidebook-cited. Against: no counted source I could open, tiny, opening reliability unknown.

name: Krangket Island
reason: Rules 1-3: Wikivoyage Do names it with a 5-minute ferry every half hour, villages, lodge.
objection: Little to do for 30 minutes besides stroll villages.

name: Siar Island
reason: Rule 1: only a travel listing, no counted source and no detail on what to do.
objection: Could be a swimming/picnic island if a guide named it.

name: Samun Island
reason: Rule 1: named only in a listing with no detail.
objection: Same as Siar; no evidence of anything to do.

name: Bagabag Island
reason: Rules 1-2: no counted source and no visitor infrastructure; listing warns of currents.
objection: Reef diving may exist but only anecdotal.

name: Karkar Island
reason: Rules 1-2: business guide (30 km from Madang, volcanic, bilums) plus Wikivoyage region page saying the crater can be visited.
objection: Hard to reach and little infrastructure; Madang-based visitors rarely go.

name: Balek Wildlife Sanctuary
reason: Rules 1-3: named by Wikivoyage Madang-Morobe See (sulphur spring, Robinson Crusoe film location) and the city guide, 20-30 min from Madang.
objection: Tours via an operator and village-run, so opening is unreliable.

name: Bil Bil Village
reason: Rule 1: single city-guide mention (clay pot making), tour only.
objection: For: traditional pottery village on the coast is a real cultural draw. Against: one source, operator tour, village.

name: Hobe Village
reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Do names village stay with birdwatching and WWII hideouts.
objection: For: Wikivoyage names it with contacts and activities. Against: it is mainly a homestay and not a drop-in stop.

name: Haya Village
reason: Rule 2: a village guesthouse is accommodation, not a sight.
objection: Same Wikivoyage entry as Hobe with birdwatching.

name: Madang Japanese WWII Airfield
reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Do names it (overgrown airfield, Betty bomber), half-day tour.
objection: For: distinctive WWII relics, source names it. Against: one source, jungle-covered, access via tour, exact site unclear.

name: Tupira Surf Club
reason: Rule 1: one city-guide mention; a surf break 90 min up the coast.
objection: For: named as the place to surf, hosted 2017 World Longboard Championships. Against: one source, surf club venue, remote.

name: Mitchell Bomber Wreck (Madang)
reason: Rule 1: Underwater Asia names it as an excellent WWII plane wreck; only one dive guide opened.
objection: For: permanent dive site named by a guide. Against: one source, shallow wreck, divers only.

name: Planet Rock
reason: Rule 1: Underwater Asia calls it one of the area's most famous dive sites; no second source found.
objection: For: famous site. Against: one source, advanced current/shark dive, only via operators.

name: Magic Passage
reason: Rules 1-2: two dive guides (Divernet, Underwater Asia) name it, 5 minutes by boat from Madang Resort; the site, not the operator, is the spot.
objection: Dive-only and via a resort boat.

name: USS Boston Wreck
reason: Rules 1-2: Divernet and Underwater Asia both name it, 30 m wreck 'one of the best dives in the world' per travel writers.
objection: Technical-depth dive reachable only by operator boat.

name: Coral Queen Wreck
reason: Rule 1: one dive guide (night dive with flashlight fish).
objection: For: distinctive night-dive draw. Against: one source, divers only.

name: Babang Island
reason: Rules 1-2: liveaboard-only remote dive island named by one dive guide, rarely visited.

name: Purdy Islands
